mentions.note: Irish Guards; British League hammer thrower; to rejoin his Battalion early 1984

photos.c: Right; Terry Welsh was the only member of the Irish Guards who remained in London when they were posted to Germany two years ago. It would be hard to find a first team man with greater enthusiasm for Belgrave and a feature of the season has been the support of our British League efforts by Terry and his family. Terry has helped the field men to hold their own in terms of points gained and he and Bill Treharne have together added respectability to the hammer. Sadly Terry is to join his Battalion early in 1984 and it looks as though we will be losing his services next season. Thanks for your support Terry. We look forward to your return to our ranks.
